title: Stablegains stablecoin yield service becomes available
description: Stablegains offered a centralized stablecoin-yield product that accepted customer deposits and generated returns through TerraUSD and Anchor-related exposure.
notes: The exact launch date remains approximate and should be replaced by a stronger archived first-party launch source.

title: TerraUSD depeg undermines Stablegains yield strategy
description: TerraUSD began losing its intended dollar peg, directly impairing the UST- and Anchor-linked strategy used by Stablegains.
notes: The broader TerraUSD collapse unfolded over several days; this date marks the start of the decisive depeg period.

title: Stablegains yield service becomes economically nonfunctional
description: After TerraUSD and LUNA collapsed, Stablegains could no longer operate the stablecoin-yield product on the basis presented to customers.
notes: This is an operational end classification for the customer-facing yield service, not a finding that Stablegains entered a formal bankruptcy proceeding on this date.
